hero.eyebrow: Plait · the work inbox for teams
hero.title: Five tools, one thread.
hero.lede: Plait pulls the email, chat, docs, tickets and invites your team juggles into one timeline, sorted into work with an owner. Scroll and watch a week untangle.

stages.c: Monday, 9:14. Forty-seven open threads across five tools, and nobody sure which ones are theirs.
Connect the tools once. Every thread, mention and invite flows into Plait. Nothing copied by hand.
Plait reads who owns what and when it is due, and sorts each thread into a lane.
Threads become cards with an owner and a date. The original conversation is one click away.
Work moves to done where everyone can see it. Replies sync back to the tool they came from.
Friday, 4:30. Three open threads, each with an owner. The other tools are still there; you just do not live in them.

items.q: Do we have to move off our tools?
items.a: No. Plait reads from them and writes back to them. People who prefer Slack or Gmail keep answering there; the card updates either way.
The text of the threads you connect and who they belong to, encrypted at rest. Attachments stay where they are; Plait links to them.

items.q: Can we try it with the whole team?
items.a: Team and Scale come with a 14-day trial for any number of seats, no card needed. You only pay if you keep it.
You keep read-only access for 30 days and can export every card, with its history, as CSV or JSON.

start.title: Your workspace, set up in a minute.
start.sub: Name it, pick the tools to connect and how big the team is. The preview builds as you go. Free for up to five people, no card needed.
